_doc: TNT Area fragment: the warden and the duck hunter, the inner fence and the plant sump gates, igloo 7 (night 4) and the power plant lair (night 5).

superfund_fence.name: The inner Superfund fence
superfund_fence.locked: Chain-link, eight feet, EPA signs every thirty yards. The gate is padlocked and the padlock is new.

check.prompt: Talk your way past the warden: you know what this ground was called
Talk your way past the warden: offer to trace the plant's power draw

plant_lower.name: The boiler pit stairs
plant_lower.locked: The stairs go down into black water, waist deep and steaming. The sump pump is running on no power at all.

plant_roost.name: The thing at the top of the stairs
plant_roost.locked: The plant is empty. Whatever uses it is not here yet.

facts.title: November 1966, with the sheriff

gates.prompt: You were nineteen in '66. The plant caretaker's boy. You drove the sheriff out here.

lines: I was nineteen. I drove the sheriff and two deputies out here the morning after, because I had the keys and they didn't.
Prints in the frost by the plant door. Three toes, long as my arm. Deputy cast two of them in plaster.
Next day two men in suits came to the sheriff's office and took the casts. Receipt and everything. Sheriff never said another word about it, and he was a man who said words.

facts.title: The north pond

gates.prompt: The north pond isn't frozen. Everything else is.

lines: Red's the iron and the TNT washing out of the ground. Been red since the war. That's not the thing.
Thing is, it don't freeze. Ten below in January, every pond on this ground was iron, and that one steamed. Ducks won't land on it. Ducks'll land on anything.

facts.title: The sump pump

gates.prompt: There's a current draw out here. Something inside the fence is running.

lines: Plant's sump pump runs. Some nights. There's no line to that building, hasn't been since '45. I pulled the fuses myself in '81.
You can hear it from the gate on a still night. Thump, thump, thump, and then it stops for a while. Then three more.
I didn't count 'em. I'm telling you what you'd hear.

facts.title: Who he lets inside
lines: Lyle's my wife's brother. He shoots the north pond because I let him, and he gets out when I tell him.
I tell him on the nights the plant lights up. He's never argued once. Lyle argues about the weather.
Windows. Top floor. Like someone walking through with a lamp, slow. Nobody's up there. I've been up there.

facts.title: The vest in igloo 7

gates.prompt: Lose anything out here, Lyle? Orange, reflective?

lines: That's my vest. Lost it deer season '92, chasing a doe I never hit. Walked into igloo 7 for the beer and came out without it.
Been meaning to go back for it. Don't go in 7 much now.
Two years to walk forty yards.

facts.title: Lights over the plant

gates.prompt: You sit by that fire all night. What do you see?

lines: Dusk, most nights since January. Two red lights come up off the plant roof, slow, like a man climbing. Then they go over the north pond and the ducks go up.
Ducks don't go up for lights. Ducks go up for a hawk.

facts.title: The crushed cans

gates.prompt: Who crushes a dozen beer cans from the top, flat, and leaves them in a row?

lines: Not me. I drank 'em. I don't fold 'em. Went back in October and every one of 'em was stepped flat and lined up by the wall.
Lined up. Like somebody wanted me to see they'd been in.
Or like a kid with a boot and an evening.
Kid'd take the vest. Kids take anything orange.

igloo_glyph_photo.title: Photo of the igloo 7 glyph
igloo_glyph_photo.text: A bird's foot inside a circle and three marks, scratched fresh into the back wall of igloo 7.

igloo_scorch_reading.title: Counter reading, igloo 7
igloo_scorch_reading.text: A warm black ring on the igloo 7 floor reads six times background. The reading climbs while you stand in it.

igloo_scorch_photo.title: Photo of the igloo 7 floor
igloo_scorch_photo.text: A ring of blackened concrete with no frost on it, in a room full of frost.

hunter_vest.title: Reflective vest from igloo 7
hunter_vest.text: A blaze-orange vest with red reflective tape, found by the door of igloo 7. In a flashlight the tape looks like two red eyes.

hunter_vest_lab.title: Lab: the vest
hunter_vest_lab.text: A 1992 Walls hunting vest, size XL, sold by the thousand. Mud, dog hair and deer blood. Nothing that isn't a hunter.

vest_photo.title: Photo of two red eyes in igloo 7
vest_photo.text: Two red bars of light at head height by the door of igloo 7, in the flash.

vest_owner.title: Lyle's vest
vest_owner.text: The duck hunter lost the vest in igloo 7 in 1992. The red eyes by the door are reflective tape.

pond_sample.title: Foam from the north pond
pond_sample.text: Warm red foam from the one pond that has not frozen all winter.

pond_sample_lab.title: Lab: the pond foam
pond_sample_lab.text: Iron oxide, nitrotoluene residue and bacteria that eat it. The reaction gives off heat; the pond warms itself. Ugly, not uncanny.

pond_reading.title: Counter reading, north pond
pond_reading.text: The north pond shore reads twice background. The water is 48 degrees in a nine-degree night.

spur_cast.title: Cast of the rail spur prints
spur_cast.text: Three toes, long, walking the rail like a wire. The prints stop at the fence and do not cross it.

spur_photo.title: Photo of the rail spur prints
spur_photo.text: A line of three-toed marks along the rail in the snow, ending at the fence.

plant_feathers.title: Feathers from the plant nest
plant_feathers.text: Grey feathers longer than a forearm, warm in the quill, worked into a nest of insulation.

plant_feathers_lab.title: Lab: the plant feathers
plant_feathers_lab.text: The barb structure matches no bird in the key. The quills are hollow and contain a fluid the lab will not name in writing.

plant_feathers_photo.title: Photo of the nest
plant_feathers_photo.text: A ring of insulation and grey feathers the size of a bathtub, in the generator hall.

plant_cold_reading.title: Thermometer, the generator hall
plant_cold_reading.text: A column of air by the bench reads 22 degrees below the room, with a hard edge, as if it had walls.

plant_glyph_photo.title: Photo of the switchgear glyph
plant_glyph_photo.text: The bird's-foot glyph on a dead switch panel, with three marks and a fourth begun.

plant_prints_cast.title: Cast of the generator hall prints
plant_prints_cast.text: A three-toed print from the plant floor. Stride eight feet. Depth says four hundred pounds.

plant_prints_photo.title: Photo of the generator hall prints
plant_prints_photo.text: Three-toed prints in concrete dust, from the boiler stairs to the nest.

warden_1966.title: The warden in 1966
warden_1966.text: The sheriff cast three-toed prints at the plant door the morning after. Two men in suits took the casts with a receipt.

warden_ponds.title: The pond that will not freeze
warden_ponds.text: The north pond has steamed all winter at ten below. Ducks will not land on it.

warden_pump.title: The sump pump
warden_pump.text: The plant's sump pump runs some nights with no power to the building. Three strokes, a pause, three strokes.

warden_lets_hunter.title: Lights in the plant windows
warden_lets_hunter.text: The warden clears the hunter out on nights the plant's top-floor windows light up. He has been up there. Nobody is.

hunter_plant_lights.title: The hunter's lights
hunter_plant_lights.text: Two red lights rise off the plant roof at dusk and cross the north pond. The ducks flush as for a hawk.

hunter_cans.title: The lined-up cans
hunter_cans.text: The hunter's cans in igloo 7 were crushed flat and lined up along the wall after he left, and the vest was not taken.

plant_glare_photo.title: Photo: the red eyes in the plant
plant_glare_photo.text: Two red points at the top of the boiler stairs, and around them nothing the flash would take. The film is otherwise fine.

plant_shriek_tape.title: Tape: the shriek
plant_shriek_tape.text: Four seconds of a cry that peaks at 2.1 kHz, then nothing. June says a sandhill crane tops out around 1.5. She says it twice.

plant_wall_mark.title: The mark behind it
plant_wall_mark.text: When the wings opened there was a mark on the wall behind it, the same bird's foot in a circle as igloo 7, and it was not there when you came in.

pond_access.title: Who shoots the north pond
pond_access.prompt: Nobody goes past the fence, you said. Lyle's been shooting the north pond all winter and watching your plant from the bank.
